Autodesk

Global AEC & MFG Software Titan · outbound links only

Autodesk is arguably the most recognized name in computer-aided design, originally famous for democratizing digital drafting via AutoCAD. Today, Autodesk dominates the global Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) market with its flagship BIM platform, Revit. The company also commands a massive presence in the manufacturing and product design (MCAD) sectors with Inventor and the cloud-native Fusion ecosystem. LearnCAD summarizes official support paths—we never mirror native files (legal).

Official entry points

  • Corporate & Main Portal: autodesk.com
  • Autodesk Support & Learning (AKN): autodesk.com/support
  • Autodesk Community & Forums: forums.autodesk.com
  • Autodesk Developer Network (ADN / Forge / Platform Services): aps.autodesk.com

Product lineup on LearnCAD

Each link opens an enriched software profile containing system structures, typical outputs, and self-study hints:

  • AutoCAD — The universal 2D/3D DWG drafting and detailing standard.
  • Revit — The preeminent Building Information Modeling (BIM) platform for architects and structural/MEP engineers.
  • Inventor — Professional-grade 3D mechanical design, documentation, and product simulation.
  • Fusion — The unified, cloud-based CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB software platform.
  • Civil 3D — Detailed civil engineering design and infrastructure documentation.

Ecosystem & Brand Segmentation

Autodesk organizes its vast portfolio into specialized industry collections designed to provide comprehensive toolsets for specific disciplines:

  • AEC Collection: Architecture, Engineering & Construction. Includes Revit, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Navisworks, and InfraWorks. Designed for end-to-end building and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • PD&M Collection: Product Design & Manufacturing. Includes Inventor, AutoCAD, Fusion, Vault, and specialized tolerances/factory design utilities. Aimed at product development and production engineering.
  • M&E Collection: Media & Entertainment. Includes Maya, 3ds Max, and Arnold. Targeted at game development, film VFX, and high-end visualization.
  • Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC): The cloud ecosystem (BIM 360, Build, Docs) connecting workflows, teams, and data at every stage of construction.
